title: Qwen 3.6 Plus
summary: Qwen 3.6 Plus is a multimodal large language model from Alibaba specifically optimized for autonomous agentic workflows and repository-level software engineering. It features a default 1-million token context window and utilizes a next-generation hybrid architecture for high-speed inference.
research_notes: Achieved a score of 78.8 on SWE-bench Verified; currently priced disruptively for production use at approximately $0.50 per 1M input tokens.

evolution.summary: Building on the Qwen 3.5 series, the 3.6 Plus release introduced always-on reasoning, a 65K output token limit, and significantly improved performance on coding benchmarks like SWE-bench.
